trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy there, so I rolled back to it. Since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Current state:** us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, with the error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) describes the rollback and the post-rollback state. The first attempt to open it was rate-limited, and the retry succeeded.

The incident also says v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed and validated. Investigating the v2.3.1 failure and confirming checkout flows end to end are still open.
